title: Illumination Bodies in Projective Geometries
summary: We extend the notion of illumination bodies to Riemannian spaces of constant curvature and to projective Finsler geometries. We prove that the derivative of their volume defines a notion of surface area for convex bodies in these settings, generalizing the affine surface area in Euclidean space. The proof is based on a general result on the derivative of weighted volumes of weighted illumination bodies in Euclidean space. In the appendix, we give some explicit examples for non-Euclidean illumination bodies.
